title: The 'Three Peaks' Faecal DNA Extraction Method for Long-Read Sequencing
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7rshm6e

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Combine stool sample with DNA/RNA Shield and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mg fresh stool or 50 µL OMNIgene GUT (Genotek #OMR-200) to 200 µL DNA/RNA Shield (Zymo Research #R1100-50).
Vortex briefly.
Place on a tube rotator for 10 minutes at 20 rpm.

steps.title: First Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes.
Retain up to 200 µL of the supernatant, depending on the size of the pellet.

steps.title: Second Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with PBS and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL PBS and resuspend material by pipetting up and down.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes.
Retain up to 100 µL of the supernatant, depending on the size of the pellet.

steps.title: Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Perform a final PBS wash of the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL PBS and resuspend material by pipetting up and down.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 100 µL PBS and 5 µL MetaPolyzyme (Merck MilliporeSigma #MAC4L-5MG).
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 35 °C for 2 hours.
Gently mix by pipetting up and down to ensure the solution is homogeneous.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample with Proteinase K and SDS.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA/RNA Shield, 10 µL 10% (w/v) SDS, and 10 µL 20 mg/mL Proteinase K.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 55 °C for 30 minutes with 300 rpm mixing.
Gently mix by pipetting up and down to ensure the solution is homogeneous.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes.
Retain up to 200 µL of the supernatant, depending on the size of the pellet.

steps.title: Bead-Beating Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis on the remaining pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 750 µL Lysis Solution.
Transfer to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube.
Bead-beat on a FastPrep instrument (e.g., FastPrep-24 5G, MP Biomedicals #116005500) for 1 cycle of 40 seconds at 6 m/s.

steps.title: Final Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed sample and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10000 x g for 1 minute.
Retain 400 µL of the supernatant.
Pool the supernatants retained from all previous collection steps into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Measure the total volume using a P1000 pipette.
Add 2 volumes of Genomic Lysis Buffer and 50 µL MagBinding beads.
Place on a tube rotator for 10 minutes at 20 rpm.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (or until clear).
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Initial Bead Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with DNA elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove from the magnetic rack.
Add 100 µL DNA elution buffer using a P1000 pipette.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Secondary Bead Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer.
Place on a tube rotator for 10 minutes at 20 rpm.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (or until clear).
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Pre-Wash Step
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with DNA Pre-Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove from the magnetic rack.
Add 900 µL DNA Pre-Wash Buffer using a P1000 pipette.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Transfer the mixture to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Place on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (or until clear).
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: g-DNA Wash Steps
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive washes with g-DNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove from the magnetic rack.
Add 900 µL g-DNA Wash Buffer using a P1000 pipette.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Transfer to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Place on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (or until clear).
Discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.
Repeat this wash process with g-DNA Wash Buffer a second time.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Using a P1000 wide-bore pipette tip, add 900 µL DNA elution buffer to the front of the tube and immediately remove it again in a fast, smooth motion to minimize bead disturbance.
Remove and discard any residual buffer from the bottom of the tube.
Add 50 µL DNA elution buffer using a P1000 pipette and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Place on a tube rotator for 5 minutes at 20 rpm.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the eluted DNA and store.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (or until clear).
Transfer the DNA to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Store DNA at 5 °C for up to a month or use immediately.
